version.changelog: Initial release: Analyze video ad performance and provide actionable creator feedback. Includes word count thresholds, pacing analysis, and feedback templates.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose, but metadata omits a required external API key and the code performs runtime package installation and network calls — these inconsistencies and side-effects warrant caution.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (analyze videos and give creator feedback) matches the included scripts and SKILL.md: both call an external transcript API and produce feedback/reports. However, the package metadata declares no required environment variables or credentials while the SKILL.md and both scripts require a MEMORIES_API_KEY for the Memories.ai API — this mismatch is unexpected and should have been declared in the manifest.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions stay within the stated purpose (fetch transcript from Memories.ai, compute word counts, produce feedback, read Excel for batch analysis). They do instruct sending video URLs to an external service (memories.ai) and reading local Excel files. The instructions explicitly require setting MEMORIES_API_KEY, which is not declared in registry metadata — a scope/visibility omission that reduces transparency.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no formal install spec in the registry (instruction-only), but scripts/generate_report.py will, at runtime, call pip via os.system to install fpdf2, pandas, and openpyxl if missing. Runtime pip installs are a moderate risk because they download and execute third-party packages without an explicit install step in the manifest — users should be aware this will modify the Python environment and reach out to PyPI.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only secret the code requires is MEMORIES_API_KEY (used to call Memories.ai for transcripts), which is proportionate to the transcript functionality. However the registry metadata lists no required environment variables or primary credential, creating an unexplained discrepancy. Also note that transcripts and video URLs will be sent to the external API — consider whether sending creator content and performance data to memories.ai is acceptable for your privacy/compliance needs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request elevated privileges or always:true. It does perform a user-scoped pip install at runtime (generate_report.py), which alters the user's Python environment (persistent change). It does not modify other skills or system-wide agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
What to consider before installing:

- Manifest mismatch: The SKILL.md and both scripts require MEMORIES_API_KEY (calls to memories.ai), but the registry metadata does not list any required env vars. Ask the publisher to update the manifest to declare MEMORIES_API_KEY explicitly.
- External network calls: The skill sends video URLs (and receives transcripts) via https://mavi-backend.memories.ai. Confirm you trust Memories.ai and understand their data retention/privacy policy before sending creator content or PII.
- Runtime package installs: generate_report.py will pip-install fpdf2, pandas, and openpyxl if missing. Expect modifications to the Python user environment; run in a virtualenv or sandbox if you want to avoid side effects.
- Inspect and test locally: If you plan to use it, review the two scripts yourself (they are small and readable), run them in an isolated environment, and verify that no other unexpected endpoints or obfuscated code exist.
- Data privacy: Batch analysis reads Excel files with creator and ROI data. Ensure you have permission to process/share that data with an external transcription service.

If you want to proceed but minimize risk: run the scripts in a disposable VM or container, set MEMORIES_API_KEY scoped to a test account, and confirm the publisher updates the skill manifest to declare the required environment variable and document runtime package installs.
